profile.headline: Software Engineer at Lockheed Martin
profile.summary: Software Engineer focused on Kubernetes, automation, DevSecOps, and scalable infrastructure solutions. Experienced in Agile leadership, cross-functional collaboration, and solving complex operational challenges in enterprise environments. Passionate about continuous improvement, reliable systems, and building strong engineering teams.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
● Developed and maintained mission critical enterprise software systems in Agile/Scrum environments, balancing high‑availability and compliance requirements
● Managed Kubernetes-based platforms using Helm charts, container registries, and automated deployment pipelines, improving release reliability and deployment speed
● Diagnosed and resolved infrastructure, CI/CD, container image, and deployment issues across distributed environments, reducing production incidents
● Partnered with developers, technical leads, and cross-functional stakeholders to streamline software delivery workflows and enhance operational efficiency
● Led DevSecOps initiatives using Ansible and containerized workloads for configuration management, security hardening, logging, and observability
● Supported system integration efforts, audit compliance, and software release activities while coordinating technical work across teams

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
-Collaborated with a team of Software Developers and Architects to develop a REST API known as Delivery Confirmation that will allow The Home Depot to match shipments to deliveries in their financial databases and is estimated to handle ~3.5 million shipments between the fiscal years of 2019 and 2020
-Deployed Web API’s through Concourse pipelines to different cloud hosting platforms such as Google Cloud Platform and Pivotal Cloud Foundry
-Practiced Agile methodologies such as ceremonies, backlog refinement, paired programming, test driven development, sprint planning, and retrospectives
-Implemented technologies such as Spring Framework, Docker, Google Cloud Platform, JUnit, Pivotal Cloud Foundry, and Cucumber in the development of Delivery Confirmation

positions.title: Information Technology Intern
positions.description:
-Designed and developed full stack desktop application to connect printers with Python GUI and PowerShell back end functionality
-Queried Oracle databases using MySQL to generate financial reports to pinpoint key spending areas for the fiscal year
-Researched and explored database and software frameworks to better understand system infrastructure for troubleshooting purposes
-Developed PowerShell scripts that expedited process of access, adding, or removing network drives from multiple devices
-Supported employees with technical issues regarding system or hardware malfunctions
-Investigated and learned current information security protocols to diagnose system defense and management
